module: Editor tool "Asset Deduplicator" (Window > Assets menu): finds duplicate files in the current level and offers to replace them with link files. It builds a hash cache (/temp/assetdeduplicator.cache.json, version 3, tied to the game version) via a job, then compares either by content hash (safe) or by file name (manual review required). Mostly useful to teams preparing levels; nothing to call from a mod.
notes: Writes/reads the cache in /temp/assetdeduplicator.cache.json; the "Reset current level asset cache" and "Deep clean asset cache" buttons invalidate it.
The cache job is launched only once per session (jobLaunchedThisSession) the first time the window is opened.
Probable minor bug: "Deep clean asset cache" sets cacheData to nil, while the rest of the code assumes a table (tableIsEmpty(cacheData) is called again afterwards) — inferred from code.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated; empty body.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is deactivated; empty body.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: draws the "Asset Deduplicator" window (cache state, hash/name mode choice, "Run assessment" button, link preview and application, cache reset buttons). Launches the cache generation job on first open.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: adds the "Asset Deduplicator" menu entry (Assets group) and registers the 'assetDeduplicator' window (500x300).
